answer: Each submission hangs on the raven of a task receipt, and the voyage is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the quartz of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
